scope: Current main-board finishing register. Supported connections and completed measurements are recorded in the current model; resolved issues are archived. Remaining hidden paths, candidate identities, values and operating behavior are listed below.

rails.name: BATTERY+
rails.path: Actual positive battery terminal -> Q1 single pad/native3 (candidate drain). TP14 is OUTA, separate from this rail.
rails.basis: User battery-path report. TP14-U5.8 measured 1.5 ohm; BP-TP14 measured 6.3 V, rejecting the former battery-side photo assignment.

rails.name: VSYS
rails.board_label: No printed net name; user-approved name
rails.path: Q1.L/native2 -> U5/MX512H pin4; L1.1 and L2.1 supply sides.
rails.basis: User-confirmed shared supply; filter terminal numbering is photo-derived. Do not join their opposite ends.

rails.name: VDD
rails.path: TP103, PIC20/C32, U5 pin1/VCC, V064/V063/V075/V082. D3.R via V082 is user-confirmed.
rails.basis: User via/test-point continuity. Distinct from VSYS and BATTERY+.

rails.name: VREF
rails.path: TP104, PIC4/RA2/V035/C39, R21.2/V071. U3.5 and R22 D/left/model2 at 1 ohm.
rails.basis: User-confirmed core plus U3.5/R22 D/left. R48.2 removed: user annotation groups it with R25/R47/C42; R23 branch rejected. PIC21/RB0/V026 explicitly withdrawn; TP16-VREF measured 800 kohm.

rails.name: GND
rails.basis: User ground reports and matched rear copper; association of every candidate branch is not thereby proved.

issues.known: C5/C6 and Q8 source/ground/outer-drain joins supported. U2/C7 supply now fed from H_RF_VDD through R5 (22 ohm): local and endpoint readings B78-B81 support this route. U2 supply = 6.3 V; direct difference to printed VDD = +1.8 V rejects old VDD tie. Q8 output-to-ANT1 accepted from visible copper and compatible B82 4.5-ohm reading with antenna fitted. Rest gate-source voltages: P=0 V, N=+6.3 V. TI lists C14R among the DBV candidate markings; absolute maximum VCC is 6.5 V, distinct from the 5.5-V recommended maximum.
issues.unknown: Exact U2 identity and compatibility with measured 6.3 V remain unresolved; candidate SN74LVC2G14 recommended supply maximum is 5.5 V. Q8 switching margin, timing and RF waveform validation are deferred by owner. B82 alone is not a zero-ohm proof; output route is photo-supported.
issues.next_action: Finish non-scope schematic items first. Review U2 fitted identification and candidate ratings from marking/datasheet evidence. Owner has an oscilloscope but explicitly defers waveform measurements until later.
issues.closed_when: U2 identity and voltage compatibility resolved; RF operating waveform validation recorded separately when the owner resumes scope work. Local RF supply/output drawing is corrected; unknown C6/C7 values remain V01.

issues.area: PIR: Q2 behavior and operating supply

issues.next_action: Local PIR connections and 3.3 V baseline are settled. Keep Q2 identity/pin-role qualification explicit. Defer raw-signal/TP16 response and supply-transient characterization to the later scope session, as requested.

issues.known: U3 input returns and R23/R42/C40, C23/R25/R48 and DNP R47/C42 paths are reconciled. VREF supplies U3 pin5; C25.1-TP6.1 measured 1.5 ohm joins the receiver filter to PIC2/RA0. Powered: VREF 0 V, TP5 0.066 V, R19 left/right 0/4.5 V. Both R19-to-Q7 joins measured 1.5 ohm. Q7 diode results: R->L 0.74 V, L->R 1.74 V, S->L 0.74 V, L->S OL. These support PNP polarity with L as base; reverse finite reading can include parallel-board paths. B71 direct QR-QL measured 0 V, consistent with no forward base-emitter bias in the latest state and the low receiver supply; stability not reported.
issues.unknown: Why the receiver is inactive and its enabled-state behavior remain unverified. Earlier separate 0/4.5 V readings conflict with the later direct 0 V; do not diagnose failure or assume simultaneous identical states. Exact Q7 identity and E/C selection remain qualified. Receiver gain/filter response and MCU interface roles are unverified; DC readings do not exclude pulses.
issues.next_action: No repeat Q7 diode, continuity or baseline DC readings. Preserve latest 0 V direct bias and 0.066 V receiver-supply result. Enabled-state receiver timing and filter response are deferred to the later scope session; exact Q7 identity/E-C mapping stays qualified.

issues.known: D6 anode is GND and cathode is VPP; forward drop is about 0.7V and reverse diode mode is OL. J1 pin order is resolved. Primary programming specification DS40001753B requires 8.0-9.0 V for high-voltage entry; low-voltage entry exists only when LVP is enabled.
issues.unknown: G3 is nonunique: MMSZ5228BS is 3.9 V; PZU2.4B is 2.4 V. Neither rating has been measured on this board. A directly connected clamp of either rating would load the required high-voltage ICSP level. The current PIC LVP configuration and actual D6 breakdown are unknown.
issues.next_action: No repeated continuity or diode-mode check. Keep D6 fitted as requested. Isolated breakdown testing is deferred. Retain the unknown breakdown/ICSP compatibility qualification; do not infer it from the G3 marking or perform a breakdown test through the PIC.
issues.closed_when: Clamp class/rating is established or explicitly bounded for reconstruction, and programming compatibility is checked.

findings.title: U2 operates above the candidate recommended supply range
findings.basis: B76 U2 supply 6.3 V and B77 U2-minus-VDD +1.8 V. TI lists C14R for SN74LVC2G14DBV; recommended VCC max 5.5 V and absolute maximum 6.5 V.
findings.reasoning: The marking supports the candidate but does not uniquely prove fitted identity. The 0.8 V excess over the recommended maximum is unresolved; being below an absolute maximum does not establish normal operation or reliability. R5 limits current; its 22-ohm value does not regulate voltage.
findings.next_action: Keep the original rail mapping and candidate qualification. Dynamic supply/drop checks belong to the deferred scope session; do not substitute a part or reconnect VDD on this evidence.

findings.title: Q3 family and pin roles remain disputed
findings.basis: 2H supports a PNP MMBTA55 candidate, but Q3 diode readings do not establish its presumed base junctions.
findings.reasoning: A fitted network can influence diode mode. Neither a PNP-to-NPN/MOSFET swap nor a copper change is justified.
findings.next_action: Leave Q3 fitted. Preserve the disputed model and qualify tuning calculations until device behavior and critical capacitances are known.

findings.title: D6 has measured polarity but unknown reverse breakdown
findings.basis: A=GND, K=VPP; forward about 0.7 V, reverse OL. G3 has multiple candidate identities. PIC high-voltage entry specification is 8-9 V.
findings.reasoning: An unmeasured 3.9-V or 2.4-V candidate is not a recovered rating. The native label now says Vbr TBD; source candidates remain in the evidence.
findings.next_action: No repeat diode-mode check and no breakdown test through the PIC. Keep identity/ICSP compatibility open with the component fitted.

findings.title: Receiver DC readings do not establish one simultaneous operating state
findings.basis: TP5 = 0.066 V; VREF = 0 V. Earlier R19 end readings were 0 and 4.5 V, but later direct Q7 QR-QL was 0 V.
findings.reasoning: Do not subtract separate readings taken at different times to diagnose a failed junction. The two 10-kohm VREF divider resistors imply half the receiver rail only under negligible loading and steady conditions.
findings.next_action: Retain the latest direct-bias reading; enabled-state and timing checks are deferred, with no repeated DC batch now.

resolved_findings.disposition: B84/B85 do not reproduce the low-resistance conflict; E09 remains open for other qualifications.
